text: 会话互发消息（DSH 网页插件）：让普通顶层会话跨越原有的父子关系查找彼此、传递任务并互相回复。它注册会话列表、消息发送和新建会话三个工具；可按标题或 ID 搜索当前工作区或所有工作区的会话，把消息并入运行中的会话或排队等待，也可在指定工作区创建带标题并以任务启动的新会话。接收方能看到发送会话的来源标注，网页端会将其显示为消息气泡。适合需要在多个独立会话间交接工作并接收回复的 DSH 用户。默认允许跨工作区，单条消息上限为 65,536 字节，无需额外 API Key。

Session Messaging connects top-level DSH conversations to find sessions, send or queue attributed messages, and open titled sessions with a first task. Search by title or ID; incoming messages show their sender. Cross-workspace access defaults on, with a 65,536-byte message limit.

「查找会话」：按标题或会话 ID 搜索顶层会话，并返回状态、最近活动时间和标题。默认只列当前工作区，也可跨工作区查询并限制返回条数。
「跨会话发消息」：向另一个顶层会话发送带来源说明的消息；运行中的会话可立即接收或排队，空闲或存储中的会话会被唤起。
「创建并启动会话」：指定标题、任务消息和可选工作区，新建一个独立会话并以该消息开始第一轮。
「来源消息气泡」：网页端识别本插件转发的消息，显示发送会话并复用 DSH 用户消息内容组件；其他触发消息仍走原渲染器。
会话列表、消息发送和新建会话只面向顶层会话；子 agent 不会显示这三个工具，需使用 DSH 自带的父子消息通道。

「整理发布说明」里的 agent 用 session_list 找到「修复登录超时」，用 session_send_message 发出问题。对方被唤醒并回复，回复又唤醒了原会话。

@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · 功能：- 🔎 **找会话** — `session_list` 按最近活跃列出可以发消息的会话：id、运行中 / 空闲、标题。默认只看当前工作区，也可以列出全部工作区或按标题搜索。
- ✉️ **发消息** — `session_send_message` 把消息送到另一个会话：正在运行的会话在下一步读到，空闲的会话立即开始新一轮，已存储（未加载）的会话先恢复再处理。
- 🆕 **开新会话** — `session_create` 在侧栏新开一个带标题的会话，用你的消息开始第一轮。新会话独立干活，看不到发起方的对话；消息里让它回报，它就会回报。
- 🏷️ **标明来源** — 收到的消息显示为用户侧气泡，上方写着「来自会话「标题」」。模型看到的是一行来源说明：哪个会话、由对方的 agent 而不是用户撰写、怎么回复。
- 🔁 **不会互相客套** — 来源说明提醒对方不要只为确认收到而回复，两个会话不会来回说「收到」「好的」停不下来。
- 🛡️ **有边界** — 不能发给自己、子 agent 会话或已归档的会话；单条消息上限 64 KB；每个会话每次运行最多开 10 个新会话；子 agent 看不到这三个工具。

@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · 工作原理：- 发消息走 `sessionController.resolveAgent`，与网页端发送 prompt 是同一条路径，必要时从存储冷恢复会话。消息带 DSH 内置的转发来源 `{ kind: 'agent-message', form: 'relay', senderSessionId }`，写进对方的会话日志。
- 开新会话走 `sessionController.create({ workspaceId })`，也就是网页端「新对话」的路径；在第一轮开始前先改好标题，因为转发的消息不会触发 DSH 的自动起标题。
- 两者都在 `withoutInitiator` 里执行：对方是独立的顶层会话，不算发送方这一轮发起的子任务。
- 来源说明以空行结尾，因为相邻的文本块到模型那里会直接拼接在一起。
- 子 agent 在 `agent/created` 时通过 `agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ deny })` 隐藏这三个工具：它们无法通过这条通道收到回复。
- 浏览器端覆盖 Chat 的 `turn-trigger` 渲染器，只接管本插件转发的消息，复用 DSH 自带的 `conversation.chat.user.content` 气泡；目标、定时任务、子 agent 等其他触发消息仍用 DSH 自带的卡片。只改显示，模型收到的内容不变。
@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · 工作原理：</details>

@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · 已知限制：> [!CAUTION]
> **被唤醒或新开的会话按它自己的设置运行。** 新开的会话使用默认模型和默认审批策略（实测为 `ask`），不继承发起会话的设置。它如果需要审批，审批请求会停在那个会话里，可能没人在看。

- 只在顶层会话之间通信；子 agent 和 Team 成员仍用 DSH 自带的 `send_message`。
- 「送达」只代表对方的收件箱接受了消息，不代表已经处理；没有重试、去重或已读回执。
- 对方正在运行时收到的消息会并入它这一轮，模型能收到，但不会显示成气泡。只有唤醒会话的消息显示为气泡。
- 气泡里不渲染 Markdown，也不折叠很长的消息。
- 发消息没有频率限制，防止来回客套靠的是来源说明里的提示。`createLimit` 存在内存里，插件重新加载或重启后清零，也不限制「A 开 B、B 再开 C」这样的链条。
- `session_create` 设的标题像手动改名一样被固定，DSH 之后不会再自动改标题。

@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · dsh-session-messaging：**Let sessions message each other** — one session can find another, send it a message, or open a new session with a task; the other side replies the same way.
@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · dsh-session-messaging： [中文](README.md) · **English**

@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · dsh-session-messaging：A community plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Every built-in message channel in DSH needs a relationship between the two sides: `send_message` only reaches a direct parent or child agent, and Agent Teams only reaches members of the same Team, so two ordinary sessions in the sidebar have no way to talk. With this plugin, every top-level session gets three tools: find sessions, send a message, and open a new session. A received message says which session it came from, and the recipient can reply with the same tool.

@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · dsh-session-messaging：

The agent in “整理发布说明” (prepare release notes) finds “修复登录超时” (fix login timeout) with session_list and sends its question with session_send_message. The other session wakes up and replies, and the reply wakes the first session again. The demo was recorded with the Chinese interface, so captions and labels appear in Chinese.

@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · Features：- 🔎 **Find sessions** — `session_list` lists the sessions you can message, most recently active first, with id, running / idle status and title. It covers the current workspace by default, and can list every workspace or search by title.
- ✉️ **Send messages** — `session_send_message` delivers a message to another session: a running session reads it at its next step, an idle session starts a new turn with it, and a stored (not loaded) session is resumed first.
- 🆕 **Open new sessions** — `session_create` opens a titled session in the sidebar and starts its first turn with your message. The new session works on its own and cannot see the creator's conversation; ask it to report back in the message and it will.
- 🏷️ **Shows the sender** — a received message appears as a user-style bubble marked “From session “title””. The model sees an attribution line: which session sent it, that the other session's agent wrote it rather than the user, and how to reply.
- 🔁 **No pleasantry loops** — the attribution line tells the recipient not to reply only to acknowledge, so two sessions don't trade “got it” and “thanks” forever.
- 🛡️ **Bounded** —

Implementation details

@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · How it works：- Sending goes through `sessionController.resolveAgent`, the same path as a prompt from the web interface, which resumes a stored session when needed. The message carries DSH's built-in relay source `{ kind: 'agent-message', form: 'relay', senderSessionId }` and is written to the recipient's session log.
- Opening a session goes through `sessionController.create({ workspaceId })`, the web interface's new-chat path. The title is set before the first turn starts, because relayed messages never trigger DSH's automatic titling.
- Both run inside `withoutInitiator`: the other side is an independent top-level session, not work started by the sender's turn.
- The attribution line ends with a blank line, because adjacent text blocks reach the model joined together.
- Subagents get the three tools hidden with `agent.ctx.tools.restrict({ deny })` in `agent/created`, since they cannot receive replies through this channel.
- The browser half overrides the Chat `turn-trigger` renderer for this plugin's relayed messages only and reuses DSH's own `conversation.chat.user.content` bubble; goals, schedules, subagent results and other triggers kee

@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · Known limitations：> [!CAUTION]
> **A session that is woken up or newly opened runs with its own settings.** New sessions use the default model and the default approval policy (`ask` in testing), not the creator's settings. If such a session needs an approval, the request waits in that session, where nobody may be watching.

@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · Known limitations：- Only top-level sessions can talk this way; subagents and Team members still use DSH's built-in `send_message`.
- “Delivered” means the recipient's inbox accepted the message, not that it was processed; there are no retries, deduplication or read receipts.
- A message that arrives while the recipient is running joins its current turn: the model receives it, but it isn't shown as a bubble. Only messages that wake a session appear as bubbles.
- Bubbles don't render Markdown and don't collapse long messages.
- Sending has no rate limit; reply loops are discouraged only by the attribution line. `createLimit` lives in memory, resets when the plugin reloads or Harness restarts, and doesn't stop chains such as A opens B, then B opens C.
- A title set by `session_create` is fixed like a manual rename, so DSH won't retitle the session later.

@tonyzdev/dsh-session-messaging README · Development：```sh
node --test test/*.test.js
```

The tests drive a mocked Harness context through delivery, opening sessions, every refusal path, list filtering and hiding the tools from subagents, and check that the browser half can parse the attribution the Host writes (they fail if the two drift apart).

> [!NOTE]
> After changing `lib/index.js`, turn the plugin off and on again on the Plugins page to load the new code, without a restart; after changing `lib/client.js`, reinstall and refresh the page.
